definitions.short: Rephidim , a place in the Desert
definitions.full: H7508. Rephidim רְפִידִים proper name, of a location station of Israel at Exodus (in P), Exod 17:1 ; 19:2 ; רְמִּידִם 17:8 ; Num 33:14-15 , Ραφιδειν . - אַרְמַּד .
definitions.rootNote: plural of the masculine of the same as 7507 ; ballusters ;

occurrences.englishText: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.
Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.
They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
